content.short: A digital gallery that supports scientific mycological research.
content.description: We are a digital gallery that supports scientific mycological research. We are passionate about mycology and believe that fungi play a crucial role in the future of technology, our species and our planet. Which is why we are compelled to give a portion of our profits to research groups that further our understanding. This exhibition saw $100k+ donated to MAPS. We feature only the highest quality artists and partner with them to deliver innovative and highly collectable pieces to the market.
